title: ComfortLease Buyout Price Table by Lease Year
content:
**ComfortLease Equipment Leases — buyout prices (USD)**

Lease year 1 is the first twelve months of the lease, lease year 2 the next twelve, and so on. The price shown is the buyout price for that lease year.

| Lease year | ComfortLease Gas Furnace | ComfortLease Central Air | ComfortLease Heat Pump | ComfortLease Furnace & Central Air | ComfortLease Dual-Fuel System | ComfortLease Ductless Multi-Zone |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | $5600 | $6900 | $8700 | $12900 | $15900 | $13200 |
| 2 | $5080 | $6260 | $7900 | $12040 | $14820 | $11990 |
| 3 | $4560 | $5620 | $7100 | $11180 | $13740 | $10780 |
| 4 | $4040 | $4980 | $6300 | $10320 | $12660 | $9570 |
| 5 | $3520 | $4340 | $5500 | $9460 | $11580 | $8360 |
| 6 | $3000 | $3700 | $4700 | $8600 | $10500 | $7150 |
| 7 | $2480 | $3060 | $3900 | $7740 | $9420 | $5940 |
| 8 | $1960 | $2420 | $3100 | $6880 | $8340 | $4730 |
| 9 | $1440 | $1780 | $2300 | $6020 | $7260 | $3520 |
| 10 | $920 | $1140 | $1500 | $5160 | $6180 | $2310 |
| 11 | — | — | — | $4300 | $5100 | — |
| 12 | — | — | — | $3440 | $4020 | — |

A dash means the schedule lists no price for that lease year on that system: the ComfortLease Gas Furnace, ComfortLease Central Air, ComfortLease Heat Pump and ComfortLease Ductless Multi-Zone schedules run to lease year 10, and the ComfortLease Furnace & Central Air and ComfortLease Dual-Fuel System schedules to lease year 12.

## Reading the table

- Each price is fixed for its whole lease year; it does not change month by month within the year.
- Hypothetical example: a ComfortLease Heat Pump lease in its lease year 4 reads $6300; the same lease in lease year 5 reads $5500.
- Hypothetical example: a ComfortLease Dual-Fuel System lease in its lease year 11 reads $5100.
